description: The static facades the branch deleted (P2-Z, SWLOR.Game.Server/Readmes/MaintainabilityRefactorFacadeRemoval.md). Read by tools/Refactor/Apply-FacadeRemoval.ps1 (SWLOR.FacadeRemoval), which keeps their callers in the branch's shape. Each entry is a "facade" named relative to SWLOR.Game.Server.Service (Taxi, or QuestService.QuestEncounter for a further facade); static callers reach its service through the property of the same name on SWLOR.Game.Server.Composition.GameServices. Optional: "explicit": true for a name that is also a namespace segment (Combat, Mimicry, Performance, Prospecting), which callers write GameServices.<Name>.X; "constants": [ { "name": "MaximumHitRate", "owner": "SWLOR.Game.Server.Domain.Combat.CombatRules" } ] for each public constant the facade repeated, with the full name of the class that holds it now. Keep the list sorted by facade. A removed service also has "facadeRemoved": true in SWLOR.Architecture.Tests/ConvertedServices.json, and each of its handlers a line in tools/Refactor/HandlerRenames.txt.
